issues.message: Only 39 blocks: too bare for a common (at least 50). Carlton wants more detail, not less.

notes.roof: flat plank lid flush with the walls
notes.purpose: Carlton's note on v1: 'otherwise good', only the sinking was wrong

visual.summary: Unchanged tiny oak hovel (now sitting on the grass): log corners, plank walls, a flat plank roof, a bed and a chest inside, with a lean-to and a lamp post on the higher levels. Carlton called it good apart from the sinking, but by the rubric it is very plain.
problems: Flat plank roof flush with the walls: a low pitched roof of stairs with one block of overhang would lift it most
All one oak colour: spruce or dark oak for the corner logs and the roof would match the rest of the village
Only if Carlton wants more: a flower or a barrel by the door
